public_hostname.description: Hostname users visit, e.g. `admin.example.com`. Set on create; cannot be changed.

origin_url.description: HTTPS URL requests are forwarded to, with an optional base path. Must be a different hostname from `public_hostname` and publicly resolvable.

health_path.description: A side-effect-free path on the origin that returns 2xx when the secret is present; used for verification. Defaults to `/`.

default.description: `authenticated` (any signed-in user, the default) or `deny` (only paths a rule matches).

rules.description: Every rule whose path prefix and methods match a request applies, and all of them must pass; deny wins. Prefixes match whole path segments, case-insensitively.

methods.description: Upper-case HTTP methods; all methods when omitted. GET covers HEAD.

effect.description: `require` (default): the conditions below must hold. `deny`: always refuse.

realm_roles_any.description: User must hold at least one of these realm roles.

client_roles_any.description: User must hold at least one of these roles on the app's client.

groups_any.description: User must be in at least one of these groups (full path).

claims_equal.description: Claims that must equal these values, e.g. `email_verified: true`.

header_mappings.description: Header name (`X-Phasetwo-Auth-*`) to claim: one of `sub`, `email`, `email_verified`, `preferred_username`, `name`, `given_name`, `family_name`, `groups`, `realm_roles`, `client_roles`.

assertion_enabled.description: Send a signed `X-Phasetwo-Auth-Assertion` JWT on every request.

assertion_claims.description: Claims to include in the assertion besides `sub`.

post_logout_redirect_uri.description: HTTPS URL to land on after sign-out; defaults to a Phase Two page.
